experiences.name: Tsukiji Outer Market Food Tour
experiences.description: Explore the bustling Tsukiji Outer Market, sampling fresh sushi, tamagoyaki, and street snacks from local vendors. This is a must for food lovers wanting authentic Tokyo flavors without the tourist markup. Ideal for an early morning visit to catch the freshest produce and seafood. Since your flight arrives late on Day 1, plan this for Day 2 morning to kick off your culinary adventure properly rested.

experiences.name: Akihabara Electric Town Tech & Culture Immersion
experiences.description: Dive deep into Tokyo's legendary tech and otaku culture in Akihabara. Visit multi-floor electronics shops like Yodobashi Camera, explore retro game arcades, anime merchandise stores, and maid cafes. This neighborhood is the global epicenter of consumer electronics and pop-tech culture. Since Day 1 is largely lost to a late arrival, schedule this for Day 2 afternoon or any subsequent day for a full experience.

experiences.name: teamLab Borderless Digital Art Museum
experiences.description: Experience one of the world's most immersive digital art installations at teamLab Borderless, a cutting-edge fusion of technology and art. Wander through interactive light forests, infinity rooms, and AI-driven exhibits that respond to your movement. This perfectly bridges Tokyo's tech culture and artistic heritage. Book tickets in advance as slots sell out quickly. Best enjoyed in the evening for the full visual impact.

experiences.name: Senso-ji Temple & Asakusa Cultural Walk
experiences.description: Visit Tokyo's oldest and most iconic Buddhist temple, Senso-ji, in the historic Asakusa district. Walk the Nakamise shopping street for traditional crafts and snacks, observe morning prayers, and explore the surrounding old-town atmosphere that reflects Edo-period Tokyo. This is a deeply cultural experience that connects you to Japan's spiritual and historical roots. Free to enter the temple grounds, with optional purchases along the way.

experiences.name: Ramen Alley Tasting Experience in Shinjuku
experiences.description: Spend an evening exploring Shinjuku's famous Omoide Yokocho (Memory Lane) and nearby ramen shops, tasting regional ramen styles from tonkotsu to shoyu. Join a small-group ramen tasting tour or go independently hopping between 2–3 highly rated local spots. This is an authentic, affordable, and deeply local food experience that showcases Japan's ramen culture. With 13 days available, this fits perfectly mid-trip when you've settled into the city rhythm.
